feature.planned_date: Task.scheduledOn only; due date is not a substitute
feature.joint_tasks: one global occurrence; planned points distributed by responsibility shares
feature.sessions: elapsed duration split at America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires calendar-day boundaries
feature.operational_activity: attributed to activity.actorId; quantities remain separate by unit
feature.completion_actor: optional completedBy recorded for new laboratory completions; historic closures remain unattributed

build.note: Vite reports the main chunk above 500 kB and dependency annotation warnings; build exits successfully.

checks: mobile page has no horizontal overflow

known_limits: Laboratory data remains in the current browser and does not synchronize between PCs.
The work-cycle view does not infer free time, configured capacity, presence, or productivity.
Historical completed tasks do not acquire a fabricated completion actor.
No Auth, D1, Supabase, API, email, or account was enabled by this implementation.
